verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair axis for a SaaS incorporation service, so the story applies. The evidence only describes Dashboard-driven workflows (documents tab, SAFEs from the Dashboard). The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are about doc readability, not an Atlas API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a documented public Atlas API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
